text:
The candidate hypothesis focuses specifically on drive-time distance, public transportation metrics, GIS tools, and a proposed cohort study evaluating transportation networks and telehealth integration. In contrast, the provided evidence is from a broad systematic review synthesizing 74 studies to identify ten contextual determinants across organizational, community, public policy, and macro-environmental levels. The candidate hypothesis does not represent the main hypothesis investigated or supported by the study.

VERDICT: REJECT
